'''Donal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a [[Donal's brother|brother]] who lived on a [[Donal's brother's farm|farm]] with his family near the town of [[Jiguuna]], but when Donal's brother was unable to pay protection money to the [[Fa'athra gang]], the criminals [[Death/Legends|killed]] the man and his family and took over the farm. A furious Donal hired outside help to wipe out the [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]], and traded a lockbox of valuables in the farm as payment.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Donal appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he gives players the mission "Protection" on Hutta.<ref name="TOR" />
